name: @proworks-hub/financialcontrolsiq
description: FinancialControlsIQ — controls where design and operating effectiveness are separate findings, an unattested population can never test effective (100% coverage of an unattested population is worth less than a sample of an attested one), SoD 'clean' is unconstructable, thresholds carry an evidenced basis or fail to load, deficiency candidates carry no severity, and a noisy rule is flagged but never disabled by the engine.
author: Steven Kreutzer
